concept: A large padlocked mouth rendered in bold geometric shapes, chains wrapped around it, set against a dark background with fragmented newspaper text visible but illegible. The mouth is slightly ajar as if straining against the lock. Use stark contrasts between deep shadows and single accent color. Style: modern propaganda poster, bold silhouettes, heavy use of solid blocks and negative space.
explanation: Today's news reveals systematic silencing across continents: journalists jailed in Egypt, a French correspondent imprisoned in Algeria, a Nigerian cleric killed, and widespread abuse of detention systems. While some leaders speak of peace (Norway, Finland), many are actively preventing voices from being heard. The padlocked mouth symbolizes the day's dominant pattern—censorship, imprisonment, and the suppression of speech and dissent.

headlines.title: Norway and Finland leaders hold rare call with Putin
headlines.summary: An end to the conflict in Ukraine "will not be achieved through silence," Finland's President Alexander Stubb said.

headlines.title: Ceasefire extended across Ukraine's Kherson region, officials say
headlines.summary: The truce was originally planned for the stranded residents of Oleshky, and Russia and Ukraine say no breaches have been reported.

headlines.title: Mbappé sorry for 'ill-judged' Mao remark after backlash in China
headlines.summary: The France star had referred to the former Chinese leader as a "dictator" during an interview about memes.

headlines.title: Lula's comeback in Brazil dents Trump's ambitions for Latin America
headlines.summary: The Trump-Lula relationship may have thawed, but several issues could reignite tensions between the two leaders.

headlines.title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled by leopard
headlines.summary: The woman began her career at the park when she was 17 and had worked there on-and-off for four decades.

headlines.title: Ex-wife of Zimbabwe's vice-president freed after collapse of attempted murder case
headlines.summary: Marry Mubaiwa had been held on remand for seven years after being charged in 2019 for her then husband's attempted murder.

headlines.title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case
headlines.summary: The trio - two of whom were high-profile US real estate moguls - were found guilty using their social status to lure women to parties and then raping them.

headlines.title: Egypt court fines journalist Lina Attalah and orders news site's closure
headlines.summary: Amnesty International said the verdict against Attalah and independent outlet Mada Masr represented "a crushing blow to press freedom".

headlines.title: Ghanaian twin brothers and US woman plead guilty to $9m romance scam
headlines.summary: The group targeted elderly people across US and Europe, luring them into romantic relationship before persuading them to transfer large sums of money.

headlines.title: Ballon d'Or ceremony raises case of French sports journalist jailed in Algeria
headlines.summary: He is in jail accused of supporting terrorism after travelling to the politically sensitive region Kabylie.

headlines.title: Deaths in detention cells in Nigeria were entirely preventable, inquiry finds
headlines.summary: Overcrowding and poor ventilation caused the deaths of 33 detainees in a prison cell in Minna state.

headlines.title: Controversial Islamic cleric shot dead in northern Nigeria
headlines.summary: Yahaya Masussuka had posted videos in which he rejected some elements of mainstream Islam.
